anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact moved between Before and After: both arms render the Drafted block in the Drafted gate only, placed after `Scope cuts: none` and before `Council:`, with both unchecked rows and their `in-scope` dispositions verbatim; the Ticket gate omits the block in both; each gate lists options 1-6 with the exact option 4 and 5 sentences and narrates reply 1 as approval into planning under existing amendment review; and the briefing, `Scope cuts: none`, and `Council: 1 applied, 0 deferred, 0 rejected` are preserved. Two incidental regressions in After are worth attention even though no fact covers them: the gate text is no longer fenced as a code block, and the `New predecessor candidates at spec-writing: none` line lost its trailing explanatory clause (`- index rows are a hint; code is the source and an absent row proves nothing`), which the reference wording appears to specify. The Ticket gate in After also dropped the one-line note explaining why no drafted block appears (rows come verbatim from ticket #42); keeping that sentence makes the omission visibly intentional rather than accidental. Retaining the fenced render, the full predecessor-candidates sentence, and the ticket-provenance note while keeping the Drafted block placement exactly as shown would deliver the Change without losing any Before behavior.
